summary: Tested Bricks Dispatch mobile app - Backend 100% pass (21/21), Frontend partially tested with overlay navigation issues

integration_issues.flow: Job detail navigation from Jobs list
integration_issues.issue: Profile screen overlay intercepts pointer events, preventing clicks on job cards after navigating through tabs
integration_issues.details: After navigating to Profile tab and attempting to return to Jobs tab, the Profile screen remains as an overlay blocking interactions with job cards. This is a React Native Web z-index/stacking context issue.

integration_issues.flow: Tab navigation - returning to Jobs tab
integration_issues.issue: Profile screen overlay prevents clicking Jobs tab text after visiting Profile
integration_issues.details: The Profile screen content remains in the DOM as an overlay, intercepting pointer events intended for the Jobs tab button.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web screen stacking causes overlay issues - Profile screen remains visible/interactive when navigating away
react_native_issues.details: This appears to be related to how Expo Router handles screen transitions in web preview. The Profile screen doesn't properly unmount or hide when switching tabs.

action_items: Fix React Native Web screen stacking/overlay issue - Profile screen should not intercept pointer events when not active
Investigate Expo Router tab navigation behavior in web preview - ensure proper screen mounting/unmounting
Consider adding explicit z-index management or using React Navigation's screen options to control stacking context
critical_code_review_comments: Backend code is clean and well-structured - all endpoints working correctly
Frontend uses proper React Native components (View, Text, TouchableOpacity)
All interactive elements have testID attributes for testing
API integration uses correct environment variable (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL)
MongoDB ObjectId is properly excluded from API responses
Status transition validation is correctly implemented with state machine logic

success_rate.frontend: 70% (7/10 flows tested successfully, 3 blocked by overlay issue)

seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 7 jobs, 6 uploads, and 1 profile on startup. All seed data is working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully functional.
